CITY OF CHEYENNE – PROPOSED AMENDMENT: Amendment No. 1 to the Agenda Item
No. 15 - "PLTA-26-5"



              Mapping constitute critical infrastructure security information and
              proprietary operational detail, shall be maintained as confidential to the
              fullest extent permitted by law, and are exempt from disclosure under section
              1.1.8 of this code.
   k. Fees and Required Improvements Applicable. Any fees applicable to development
      generally, including but not limited to impact fees, application fees, utility fees, and
      penalty or enforcement fees are applicable to data center development. Any
      improvements required for the development of sites or subdivisions are applicable
      to data center development.
   l. State and Federal Laws Applicable. All applicable federal and state regulations
      apply to data centers. The City is authorized to request evidence of compliance with
      state or federal regulations.
   m. Applicability and Transition.
          1. A data center use lawfully established, or for which substantial construction
              has occurred in reliance on a valid permit, before January 1, 2027, is a legal
              use and may continue, subject to the nonconforming-use provisions of
              Article 1 and to generally-applicable health-and-safety standards.
          2. This section does not impair vested rights recognized under Wyoming law
              or rights under a development agreement approved by the City Council
              before January 1, 2027, except to the extent the City lawfully exercises its
              police power for the public health, safety, and welfare. A development
              agreement approved on or after that effective date is governed by section
              1.1.9 and does not exempt a development from this section except as this
              Code expressly authorizes.
          3. Nothing in this section surrenders or limits the City's legislative or police
              power."

To the extent required by this amendment renumber as necessary. RINNE
